grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a traditional condiment; horseradish sauce sits with mustard as a long-standing cupboard staple.

supermarket.reason: Mackerel fillets, new potatoes, radishes, rocket and crème fraîche are all everyday Tesco items.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a small bowl and simple roasting.

works.reason: 750g potatoes, 300g radishes and eight mackerel fillets suit four, and the 220°C timings will roast the potatoes through and crisp the fish without drying it.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers halving the potatoes and radishes and wedging two onions, the 20+10+10 minute roast matches the 40 printed, and the active work is light enough for a quick dinner.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including dill, lemon, salt and pepper, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Roast radishes are named in the title and form a substantial part of the tray, which suits a mid-May evening alongside the new potatoes.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oily fish, potatoes, vegetables and greens make a balanced, appealing family dinner.
